goal: Robot-diversity depalletize: a UR10 (suction) destacks a 4-cube vertical column TOP-DOWN into a bin — extends the task="depalletize" top-down capability to a 2nd robot.
thoughts:
Color-routing on UR10 pedestal scene:
1) UR10 base + table + pedestals same as CP-81.
2) Cube_1 = red, Cube_2 = blue. Set semantic_label color and visual material via create_material + assign_material.
3) Two bins: /World/Bin_red at (0.5, -0.4, 0.75) and /World/Bin_blue at (0.5, -0.55, 0.75) — different y to keep separate.
4) drop_targets dict: {'red': '/World/Bin_red', 'blue': '/World/Bin_blue'}.
5) Validates raycast workaround integrates with color-routing dispatch — cube finds correct bin per its semantic label.
6) simulate_traversal_check measures Cube_1 → Bin_red only.

code_template:
create_scene_baseline(table_size=[3.0, 1.4])

robot_wizard(robot_name="ur10", dest_path="/World/UR10", position=[0, 0, 0.75], orientation=[1, 0, 0, 0])

surface_gripper(robot_path="/World/UR10", ee_link="/World/UR10/ee_link", grip_threshold=0.02, force_limit=200.0, torque_limit=200.0)

# Pedestal supporting the stack (UR10-friendly height, like CP-82)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.5, 0.4, 0.86], scale=[0.14, 0.14, 0.10])
apply_api_schema(prim_path="/World/Pedestal", schema_name="PhysicsCollisionAPI")

# 4-cube vertical column on the pedestal (top at z=0.91), faces touching
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_1", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.5, 0.4, 0.935], size=0.05)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_2", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.5, 0.4, 0.985], size=0.05)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_3", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.5, 0.4, 1.035], size=0.05)
create_prim(prim_path="/World/Cube_4", prim_type="Cube", position=[-0.5, 0.4, 1.085], size=0.05)
for _p in ("/World/Cube_1","/World/Cube_2","/World/Cube_3","/World/Cube_4"):
    for _api in ("PhysicsRigidBodyAPI","PhysicsCollisionAPI","PhysicsMassAPI"):
        apply_api_schema(prim_path=_p, schema_name=_api)
    apply_physics_material(prim_path=_p, material_name="rubber")

create_bin(prim_path="/World/Bin", position=[0.5, -0.4, 0.75], size=[0.25, 0.25, 0.15])

setup_pick_place_controller(
    robot_path="/World/UR10",
    robot_family="ur10",
    target_source="curobo",
    source_paths=["/World/Cube_1","/World/Cube_2","/World/Cube_3","/World/Cube_4"],
    destination_path="/World/Bin",
    task="depalletize",
    end_effector_offset=[0.0, 0.0, 0.02],
    planning_obstacles=["/World/Table", "/World/Pedestal"],
)
extension_notes: CP-82 = converted from builtin to cuRobo. cuRobo handler implements _destination_path_for via Semantics_color lookup; builtin handler doesn't.
failure_modes: set_semantic_label / Semantics_color attribute may need specific schema names — handler reads Semantics_color, Semantics_colour, Semantics_class.
Bin proximity (10cm gap between bins) may cause cube-to-wrong-bin if drop accuracy is poor.
